_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); home-improvement retail signals

classification.quality_note: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 1,385 stores in 49 states with 157 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and commercial business customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B -0.10x; -25% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.54; conservative 2yr +67%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY97-FY06, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-10.6%/yr (Q4 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +25.4%/yr (FY97-FY06 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +35.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY97-FY06); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LOW (retrospective, 2008-02-08) ◉ BUY — Ratio B -0.10x (-22.8% downside to Bear $29 / +221.9% upside to Bull $76) | Adj composite 1.65 vs market 1.11: gap +0.54 [UNDERVALUED] | -25% above the EPP floor $31 (17x FY07E $1.85) | Conservative 2-yr case: +67.3% total (+33.7%/yr) | At 12.8x FY07E the 15% hurdle price $31 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; comps -4.3% in Q3 FY07, forward sales +3% (Q4 FY07 sales guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
